$note: Build sheet for Agent Switch (sandbox-quantum/switch, Apache-2.0 + modified Commons Clause, server images 0.31.0, repo commit 94c721a of 2026-10-27). Topology is upstream's standalone compose (deploy/local/standalone-docker-compose.yml) with profiles collab on: postgres + switch-core + mattermost + the setup seeder. Dropped: the nginx `gateway` service (switch-core 0.31 serves the dashboard itself, GATEWAY_UI_DIR is baked into the image) and the tuwuneldata volume (only legacy upgrades read it). init-db has no Railway equivalent, so boot.py (embedded as SWITCH_BOOT, contract-tested by test/boot.sh) creates the databases and the unprivileged runtime role, then makes the listener dual-stack. Policy gate: CLEAR; traffic only reaches messaging workspaces the deployer connects. Commons Clause forbids selling hosting of it: staff ruling 2026-08-08 says template it, an owner takedown unpublishes without a strike. upsert.py strips every $note key and mints fresh UUIDs.
name: Agent Switch

source.$note: Railway's own Postgres image. 16 to match upstream compose (Railway's template default is 18).

PGDATA.$note: Subdirectory: Railway volumes ship a lost+found that initdb refuses.

POSTGRES_USER.description: Superuser. Switch runs migrations as it (DB_OWNER_USER), never requests.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Switch's database. The mattermost one is created by switch at boot.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time Postgres gets to shut down cleanly.

deploy.$note: Start commands are exec'd raw, so a shell writes the shim out of its variable and execs it. No quotes inside on purpose: Railway's argv parser strips backslash escapes.

SWITCH_BOOT.$note: Replaced with the contents of boot.py by upsert.py and build_source.py.
SWITCH_BOOT.description: Boot shim: creates the database role, then starts Switch. Do not edit.

PORT.description: Port the API and dashboard listen on.

SERVER_HOST.description: IPv6 any; the boot shim makes it serve IPv4 too.

COLLABORATION_CALLBACK_HOST.$note: Port 8081 receives Mattermost button presses over the private network, which is IPv6.
COLLABORATION_CALLBACK_HOST.description: Listener for chat app button callbacks (private network only).

DB_OWNER_USER.description: Schema owner, used only for migrations and grants.

DB_USER.$note: Must not be the owner: switch-core refuses to start if requests would bypass row-level security.
DB_USER.description: Unprivileged runtime role every request runs as.

ID_SERVER_NAME.$note: Upstream compose uses localhost. It is a naming scheme, never contacted, and changing it later orphans every account and room.
ID_SERVER_NAME.description: Suffix of every account and room id. Cannot be changed after first boot.

SECRET_KEYS.$note: Format <id>:<secret>, current key first. Signs sessions and encrypts stored API keys.
SECRET_KEYS.description: Master key. Keep a copy: losing it makes stored agent API keys unreadable.

AGENT_REGISTRATION_TOKEN.description: Admin registration key agents register against.

GATEWAY_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email you sign in to the Switch dashboard with.

GATEWAY_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Dashboard password for the admin email. Read it here after deploy.

GATEWAY_COOKIE_SECURE.description: Railway serves https, so session cookies are Secure.

GATEWAY_PUBLIC_URL.$note: Also the --server the dashboard's Add machine dialog prints for agent controllers.
GATEWAY_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public API URL (Switch Console server URL).

MESSAGING_PUBLIC_URL.description: URL Slack, Teams, Discord and Telegram call back to.

OUTBOUND_ALLOWED_PRIVATE_HOSTS.$note: Switch refuses private addresses unless listed; the bundled Mattermost lives on one.

FEATURE_FLAGS_ENABLED.$note: The set Switch Console turns on for a new server it runs (console/.../managed-switch-server/env-file.ts). agent_management is what lets agent controllers enroll from the dashboard.

CONTROLLER_TOKEN_SECRET.description: Signs the tokens agent controllers use.

source.$note: Pinned like upstream: Switch Console embeds this Mattermost's web UI and depends on its DOM.

deploy.$note: Restarts until switch's boot has created the mattermost database.

RAILWAY_RUN_UID.$note: The image runs as uid 2000; Railway volumes are root-owned.
RAILWAY_RUN_UID.description: Run as root so Mattermost can write its volume.

MM_SQLSETTINGS_DATASOURCE.description: Mattermost database (created by switch at boot).

MM_SERVICESETTINGS_ENABLEONBOARDINGFLOW.description: The onboarding modal blocks the room view embedded in Switch Console.

MM_DISPLAYSETTINGS_CUSTOMURLSCHEMES.description: Makes agents' switchdash:// session links clickable.

MM_SERVICESETTINGS_ENABLEUSERACCESSTOKEN.description: The Switch bridge authenticates with access tokens.

MM_SERVICESETTINGS_ALLOWEDUNTRUSTEDINTER.description: Lets message buttons call switch over the private network.

MM_TEAMSETTINGS_ENABLEOPENSERVER.$note: Upstream has true, which is fine on localhost. On a public URL it is an open signup chat server, so off; the seeder creates accounts with the admin session.
MM_TEAMSETTINGS_ENABLEOPENSERVER.description: Off: only the admin creates accounts or sends invite links.

MM_PLUGINSETTINGS_PLUGINSTATES.description: Copilot and Calls cannot work in this stack, so both are off.

deploy.$note: One-shot seeder, idempotent: Mattermost admin, team and owner account, registers the bridge, links the owner. Exits 0 when done. Reruns (any variable edit redeploys it) go through setup_boot.py, because upstream's seeder crashes on Mattermost's closed-signup 403 when the admin already exists (found 2026-10-27, test/setup_boot.sh).

SETUP_BOOT.$note: Replaced with the contents of setup_boot.py by upsert.py and build_source.py.
SETUP_BOOT.description: Rerun shim for the seeder. Do not edit.

SWITCH_URL.$note: Public https on purpose: the gateway cookie is Secure, so a login over private http keeps no session.
SWITCH_URL.description: First deploy only. Switch URL the seeder signs in to.

MATTERMOST_URL.description: First deploy only. Mattermost URL the seeder uses.

MATTERMOST_URL_FOR_SWITCH.description: First deploy only. Mattermost URL switch connects to.

MATTERMOST_PUBLIC_URL.description: First deploy only. Mattermost URL people open.

MATTERMOST_CALLBACK_BASE_URL.description: First deploy only. Where Mattermost delivers button presses.

MATTERMOST_ADMIN_USER.description: First deploy only. Mattermost system admin username.

MATTERMOST_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: First deploy only. Mattermost system admin password.

MATTERMOST_TEAM_NAME.description: First deploy only. Mattermost team the bridge uses (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens).

MATTERMOST_USER.description: First deploy only. Your Mattermost username, linked to the dashboard admin.

MATTERMOST_USER_EMAIL.description: First deploy only. Email of your Mattermost account.

MATTERMOST_USER_PASSWORD.description: First deploy only. Password of your Mattermost account.

GATEWAY_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: First deploy only. Dashboard admin email.

GATEWAY_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: First deploy only. Dashboard admin password.

source.$note: Built from image/ in this repo by .github/workflows/agents-image.yml (public repo, so GHCR pulls anonymously). Upstream publishes no controller image. Tag = controller version + template revision.

deploy.$note: boot.mjs supervises the controller itself (upstream's exit-code rules), so the container only exits on SIGTERM.

volumeMounts.$note: HOME and the controller identity live here: provider logins, agent workspaces, session state. The entrypoint chowns it to the node user.

SWITCH_URL.description: Switch server this machine enrolls with (must be https).

GATEWAY_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: First boot only. Dashboard admin used once to mint this machine's enrollment code.

GATEWAY_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: First boot only. Password for the above.

MACHINE_NAME.description: First boot only. Name this machine gets in Switch (pick it as an agent's run location).
